"The Countdown"
Warm up: Get Loose and hit some light KB Swings 3 sets of 10 reps.
1. Back Squat 5 reps @ 65% rest 2:00, 4 reps @ 75% rest 2:00, 3 reps @ 80% rest 2:00, 2 reps @ 87% rest 2:00, 1 rep @ 92% rest 2:00
2. a. Bench Press
* same as above
super set b. One Arm DB Rows 5 sets of 5 reps
rest 2:00 to 2:30 between each super set
3. Close Grip Bench Press @ 33% of bench press max
* Cardio. Get 100 reps in the fewest sets possible. Rest at your discretion.
Recovery: Steak & mashed Potatoes · Big Sleep 8+ hrs · 30 min Walk
